in_hebrew.name: קריסטי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קריסטי הוא נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'Χριστός' (כריסטוס), שפירושה 'המשיח' או 'המושיע'. הוא מתייחס לישוע המשיח, המושיע הנוצרי. השם קריסטי משמש ככינוי לנוצרים, שמאמינים בישוע כבמושיע ומלך העולם.

in_greek.name: Χρήστι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Χρήστι προέρχεται από το Χριστός (Χristos), που σημαίνει 'ο Μεσσίας' ή 'ο Σωτήρας'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο Χριστός αναφέρεται στον Ιησού Χριστό, τον Σωτήρα και τον Βασιλιά. Το όνομα Χρήστι είναι ένδειξη πίστης και δέσμευσης στον Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Cristi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Christi derivatur ex Graeco 'Χριστός' (Christos), quod significat 'Unctus' vel 'Salvator'. In Ecclesia primitiva, Christus est titulus Iesu Christi, Salvatoris et Regis. Nomen Christi significat fidem et devotionem ad Christum.

in_english.name: Cristi
in_english.long_meaning: The name Christi originates from the Greek word 'Χριστός' (Christos), meaning 'anointed one' or 'savior'. It refers to Jesus Christ, the central figure in Christianity. The name Christi signifies faith and devotion to Christ, reflecting the Christian belief in Jesus as the Messiah and Savior. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing spiritual connection and commitment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Cristi or Christ carries a rich cultural history, representing the popular Christian deity who is the central figure of the faith. This name has been used since ancient times and continues to be a common name among Christians around the world.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Cristi is a powerful reminder of the sacrifice and love of Jesus Christ. It signifies the idea of salvation, hope, and eternal life that is promised to believers through faith in Him. The name Cristi stands for the embodiment of God's grace and compassion, a source of inspiration and strength for countless individuals throughout history and around the world. Ultimately, the name Cristi represents the very foundation of the Christian faith and serves as a constant reminder of the infinite love and mercy of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cristi is a variant of Christ, symbolizing the bearer's deep connection with the teachings and love of Jesus Christ. The name is a reminder to live a life guided by Christ's wisdom and compassion.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, the term 'Christ' is a title for Jesus Christ throughout the New Testament.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Cristi was a common name in medieval Romania. The name Cristi carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Cristi was a popular name among the Romanian population during the Middle Ages.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
